verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a 2FA authenticator. The evidence shows only a fixed built-in behavior, not a way for users to schedule their own recurring jobs or workflows: one local backup per day, created when the app is opened. The CLI's 'automatically backup' claim would need the user's own external scheduler such as cron, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. So the scheduling axis applies here, but there is no evidence of a user-configurable scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
